# 3D Model Rendering Path — Mechanics Map

All paths absolute. Line numbers current as of this read.

## 1. The editor-model shader: `scene3d_wgsl`

**Location:** `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/framework/gpu/shaders.zig:748-988` (`pub const scene3d_wgsl`). It is `oct_decode_wgsl ++ <string>`. This is the pipeline that draws every editor/studio mesh (`<Scene3D.Mesh>`), painted models included. Built once into `g_pipeline` from `shaders.scene3d_wgsl` at `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/framework/gpu/3d.zig:8296`.

**Bindings (group 0 = scene, group 1 = diffuse):** `shaders.zig:798-804`
- `@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> S: SceneUniforms;` (visibility vertex+fragment)
- `@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> lights: array<Light>;` (fragment)
- `@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> SH: ShadowUniforms;`
- `@group(0) @binding(3) var shadow_tex: texture_depth_2d;`
- `@group(0) @binding(4) var shadow_smp: sampler_comparison;`
- `@group(1) @binding(0) var diffuse_tex: texture_2d<f32>;`
- `@group(1) @binding(1) var diffuse_smp: sampler;`

The Zig-side layout that must match is created at `3d.zig:8397-8434` (`scene_bgl_entries` / `scene_bg_entries`). Note `min_binding_size` pins: binding 0 = `@sizeOf(SceneUniforms)`, binding 2 = `@sizeOf(ShadowUniforms)`.

**Varyings — `struct VertexOutput`** (`shaders.zig:823-835`):
- `@builtin(position) clip_pos`
- `@location(0) world_pos: vec3f` — WORLD space
- `@location(1) world_normal: vec3f`
- `@location(2) uv: vec2f`
- `@location(3) inst_color: vec4f`
- `@location(4) @interpolate(linear) screen_y: f32`
- `@location(5) bary: vec3f` (from `vid % 3`, wireframe)

**TRAP for your feature:** there is **no object/local-space position varying**. The vertex shader has object-space `in.position` at `@location(0)` (`vs_main`, `shaders.zig:880-897`) and computes `world = model * vec4f(in.position,1)` but only passes `world.xyz`. To evaluate a WGSL material over object-space position you must add a new `VertexOutput` varying (e.g. `@location(6) local_pos: vec3f = in.position`).

**fs_main structure** (`shaders.zig:902-987`): Blinn-Phong. `tex_sample = textureSample(diffuse_tex, diffuse_smp, in.uv)` (line 910); `base = in.inst_color.rgb * tex_sample.rgb` (911). Ambient+directional (`S.light_color`), then the placed-light loop `for i in 0..u32(S.light_count)` reading `lights[i]` (924-943), then aerial fog (945-954), premultiplied-alpha out, wireframe overlay branch (966-979), alpha-cut discard (985).

**Time reaches the fragment shader already.** `SceneUniforms.time` is at byte 124 (`shaders.zig:759`, Zig `3d.zig:75`), the buffer is bound vertex+fragment (`3d.zig:8400`), and it is written every frame as wrapped wall-clock at `3d.zig:10747` and `10763`. `fs_main` can read `S.time` today with zero plumbing — the ground and grass shaders already do.

## 2. Mesh / instance data flow

**`SceneUniforms`** (Zig `3d.zig:66-87`, 192 B align 16). **`InstanceData`** (`3d.zig:102-107`, 32 B): `pos:[3]f32` (loc3), `euler:[4]u16` (loc4, deg ring), `scale:[4]f16` (loc5, metres), `color:[4]u8` (loc6, rgba). The model matrix is **rebuilt in-shader** from these factors (`rebuild_model`, `shaders.zig:840-853`) — no baked matrix.

**Vertex GPU layout — `Vertex`** (`3d.zig:53-60`, 20 B): `px,py,pz:f32`, `noct:[2]i16` (octahedral snorm16 normal), `u,v:f16`. Vertex attributes bound at loc 0/1/2 (`3d.zig:10243-10247`).

**Wire/authoring vertex format is stride-8 f32** — `(px,py,pz, nx,ny,nz, u,v)` — packed once at the upload boundary by `stageVertexRows` → `packVertexRow` (`3d.zig:9452-9463`; the `* 8` stride and `3*8` per-face are visible in `model_source.zig:244-249`). Faces become vertices as **non-indexed triangle lists, 3 verts/tri in order** (so `vid % 3` is the triangle corner, `shaders.zig:891-895`).

**TRAP for a region id:** neither the 20-byte packed `Vertex` nor the stride-8 wire row has a spare channel. To ride a per-vertex/per-face region id you must either (a) add a new vertex attribute + widen the wire row, or (b) overload the UV (the model uses one atlas texel per face, so UV carries meaning). There is currently no per-face attribute channel.

**Painted atlas → diffuse texture per model:** `paintBindGroup()` (`3d.zig:9311-9402`) creates one `rgba8_unorm` texture (`g_paint_tex`) sized to `model_paint.atlas()`, uploads the whole atlas on (re)create, and otherwise uploads only the dirty row band from `model_paint.consumeDirtyRows()` (9384-9399). In `drawScene`, a mesh whose `scene3d_geom_key` hashes to `model_paint.isTarget(...)` swaps its diffuse bind group to `paintBindGroup()` **instead of** the content-hash texture cache (`3d.zig:10903-10907`). Non-paint meshes use `getOrCreateTexBindGroup(rgba,w,h)` (`3d.zig:9207`, called at `10896-10898`) or a keyed static surface (`10908-10910`); meshes with nothing fall back to the 1×1 white default `g_default_tex_bind_group`.

## 3. Editor model viewport → host

**Cart side:** `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/cart/editor/stage/ModelView.tsx` renders `<Scene3D.Mesh hostKey=...>` with a host orbit camera; painting/geometry go through `host.__model_paint_*` doors (see `ModelView.tsx:329, 621-641`). Headless harness envs `RJIT_MODELDOC` / `RJIT_MESHOPS` are read in `cart/editor/shell/AppFrame.tsx:3687, 4741` and `ModelView.tsx:2311` (via `__env_get`), driving the same doors.

**Host doors:** `__model_*` are all registered in `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/framework/v8_bindings_core.zig` (registrations start `:3499`; declarations `:487`–`:2699`, e.g. `__model_paint_at:1878`, `__model_paint_stamp:2110`, `__model_paint_material:2158`, `__model_atlas_read:2280`, `__model_meshdoc_write:1966`). Map/ground doors (`__map_*`) live in `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/framework/v8_bindings_game_map.zig`.

**Zig files owning model mesh state (all under `framework/gpu/`):**
- `model_paint.zig` — paint target, per-face colours, the CPU atlas (`atlas()`, `paintFace`, `consumeDirtyRows`, `setTarget`, `setMaterialInk`).
- `mesh_edit.zig` — the live editable mesh (verts, selection, journal).
- `model_source.zig` — wire→interleaved vertex conversion.
- `paint_program.zig` / `paint_islands.zig` / `paintable.zig` — stroke program, UV islands.
- `mesh_journal_log.zig`, `meshdoc_format.zig`, `indexed_edit_mesh.zig` — document/undo.
- `3d.zig` — all GPU pipelines, buffers, `drawScene`, texture binding.
- `material_tex.zig` — WGSL-recipe→texture door (see §4).

## 4. Runtime WGSL composition — the reference pattern

**Yes, the host can receive a WGSL snippet from JS and compile it into a pipeline.** Two existing patterns:

**A. Ground formula (scene-pipeline, the pattern you cited) — `__map_set_ground_look`:**
- **JS:** `mapSetGroundLook(formulaWgsl, tile/flora/zonePaletteRgb)` at `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/runtime/game/map.ts:340-347` → `callHost('__map_set_ground_look', ..., formulaWgsl, ...)`.
- **Host entry:** `hostSetGroundLook` `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/framework/v8_bindings_game_map.zig:326-332` → `engine.setGroundLook(formula, ...)`.
- **Engine store:** `engine.setGroundLook` `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/framework/game/map/engine.zig:1233-1249` copies the string into `g_ground_formula` (`:1216`); readable via `groundFormula()` `:1306`. Flows into the scene node as `scene3d_ground_formula` (layout field `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/framework/layout.zig:544`; set in `world_loader/paint_runtime.zig:427` and `world_loader/scene_build.zig:665`).
- **Pipeline build:** `ensureGroundPipeline(io, environ, formula)` `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/framework/gpu/3d.zig:10202-10290`. It heap-assembles the module: `scene3d_ground_prefix ++ effect_assemble.MATH ++ formula ++ scene3d_ground_epilogue` (`:10217-10218`), `createShaderModule` (`:10232`), `createRenderPipeline` into `g_ground_pipeline` (`:10276`). **Cache key = `std.hash.Wyhash.hash(0, formula)` stored in `g_ground_formula_hash`** (`:10207-10208, 10285`) — a changed formula rebuilds, an unchanged one is a no-op. Called from `drawScene` at `3d.zig:11251` when a child carries `scene3d_ground_formula`.
- **Shader contract:** the injected snippet must define `fn hf_ground_rgb(uv: vec2f) -> vec3f`. Prefix declares `@group(0) SceneUniforms` + `@group(1) @binding(0) var<storage,read> D: array<f32>` (`shaders.zig:1673-1674`); epilogue's `fs_main` calls `hf_ground_rgb(in.uv)` and applies the same Blinn-Phong/fog (`shaders.zig:1782-1803`). `effect_math.wgsl` (fbm/snoise, via `effect_assemble.MATH`) is available to the formula.

**B. Material texture (model-scoped bake) — `__model_paint_material(key, wgsl, data, size, scale)`:** `v8_bindings_core.zig:2158-2209`. Renders arbitrary JS-supplied WGSL **once** to an offscreen texture via `material_tex.bakePixels` → `effects.renderShaderToPixels` (`/home/siah/creative/reactjit/framework/gpu/material_tex.zig:87-90`). This is a bake-to-pixels path, not per-frame. The sibling `material_tex.materialize()` (`:27-31`) installs a WGSL-rendered texture under a `scene3d_tex_key` a mesh samples. **These prove the JS→WGSL→pipeline compile path exists at model scope**, but neither currently evaluates per-frame over object-space position — that is the new capability your feature adds (closest analog: pattern A, adapted to `scene3d_wgsl` with an object-space varying).

## 5. Placed lights

**`Light` struct** (Zig `3d.zig:151-162`, 64 B, comptime-asserted `:170-173`; WGSL twin `shaders.zig:775-786`): `pos:[3]f32`, `range:f32`, `dir:[3]f32`, `cos_outer:f32`, `color:[3]f32`, `intensity:f32`, `cos_inner:f32`, `kind:f32` (0 point / 1 spot), `_a`, `_b` reserved.

**`MAX_LIGHTS = 256`** (`3d.zig:168`). Overflow dropped loudly (`3d.zig:10409`).

**`g_lights_buf`** (`3d.zig:8093`): storage buffer, `MAX_LIGHTS * @sizeOf(Light)` = 16 KB, created at `:8342-8347`, bound at group0/binding1 for the life of `g_bind_group` (`:8430`). Written each frame only if `n_placed > 0`: `queue.writeBuffer(lb, 0, &placed_lights, n_placed*@sizeOf(Light))` at `3d.zig:10750-10753`. Count carried to the shader via `SceneUniforms.light_count` (`:10760`).

**LightRig → Scene3D children:** editor authored lights ride `authoredLights: readonly LightRig[]` (`ModelView.tsx:276`, type from `../model/editMesh`). Rendered as `<Scene3D.SpotLight>` / `<Scene3D.PointLight>` children (`ModelView.tsx:2605-2617`). Primitive definitions: `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/runtime/primitives.tsx:902-923` (PointLight = omni bulb, SpotLight = pyramid with cone/range/castsShadow).

**Per-frame emission (light color set here):** `drawScene` scans scene children `3d.zig:10331-10414`. `scene3d_light` children with `scene3d_light_type` "ambient"/"directional"/"point"/"spot" (`:10353-10411`). For point/spot it builds a `Light` row (`:10389-10398`) with `.color = { child.scene3d_color_r, _g, _b }` and `.intensity = child.scene3d_intensity` (**this is where per-light color/intensity land each frame**). First shadow-casting spot claims the single 2048² shadow map (`:8352`, `SHADOW_MAP_SIZE:188`, `shadow_caster` `:10400-10406`). Ambient/directional instead set `ambient_color`/`light_color`/`light_dir` scene-wide (`:10357, 10364-10366`).

## Traps / pins summary

- **Comptime size asserts** (`3d.zig:130-143, 170-173`): `Vertex`==20, `SceneUniforms`==192/align16, `InstanceData`==32, `SlimInstance`==24, `Light`==64. Any layout change to add a region-id channel or an object-space varying that shifts these fails the build.
- **`min_binding_size` pins** on the scene bind-group layout (`3d.zig:8401, 8411`) tie the WGSL uniform struct sizes to the Zig structs — the WGSL `SceneUniforms`/`ShadowUniforms` must stay byte-identical.
- **Hand-kept shader parity:** `scene3d_ground_epilogue`, `water_wgsl`, `grass_wgsl` each duplicate `rebuild_model` and the Blinn-Phong/fog block from `scene3d_wgsl` (noted `shaders.zig:1780-1781`, `1170`, `1382`). A new varying or lighting change in `scene3d_wgsl` does not auto-propagate.
- **Ground pipeline cache key** = Wyhash of the formula string only (`g_ground_formula_hash`, `3d.zig:10207`). If you clone this pattern for models, key on the WGSL snippet (and any per-region params) or a stale pipeline persists across hot-reload.
- **`MAX_LIGHTS` = 256**, `MAX_RT_POOL` = 16 (`3d.zig:8145`), `MAX_FRAME_VERTS` = 262144 (`3d.zig:231`).
- **Paint texture aliasing:** the model paint target deliberately bypasses the content-hash texture cache (`3d.zig:10901-10906`) because single-face edits alias — reuse `paintBindGroup`'s dirty-row approach if you touch that path.
- **Object-space is available in `vs_main` but dropped:** `in.position` (loc 0) is object-space; you must add a `VertexOutput` varying to carry it to `fs_main`. `S.time` is already fragment-visible.</result>
